From the #154 Clean Code second pass. Naming, comment and small error-handling findings across the harness shell, justfile and shim, batched; the structural work in the same files is #92 and #161.

Comments that no longer tell the truth:
- `spike/regress.sh:65-68` — CLASS_RANK header says "Worst-first… infra_unavailable outranks everything" while the table holds `engine_drift`/`schema_stale`/`untyped_harness_failure` above infra and `class_severity` ranks unknown above it; rewrite to describe the actual ordering (descendant of #92's "misleading Worst-first comment", mutated rather than fixed).
- `spike/slots.sh:426-430` — `cti_slot_reclaim`'s comment begins mid-thought; the sentence naming what the function does was lost in an edit.
- `spike/slots.sh:120` vs `run.sh:52` — "slot 0 is the serial tier, byte for byte" overstates: pool slot 0 writes profile `ctispike0`, a hand run `ctispike`; align the code or soften the claim.
- `spike/tier-lock.sh:6` — usage names `just cycle-spike`, deleted in c73d4fb.
- `spike/run.sh:432-434` — the same sentence twice in consecutive comment lines; delete one.
- `spike/run.sh:761` — the client-join regex's `[^_]` is the file's only magic regex without a why-comment.
- `spike/run.sh:269-271` — which `/mnt/c/Users/*` dir wins (the last match) is uncommented.
- `spike/regress.sh:601-613` — the RAM sampler's no-trailing-newline coupling between two awk calls is load-bearing and uncommented.
- `justfile` `probe` — "Under the tier lock, same as `regress`" is stale since #47 (regress takes per-slot locks).
- `extension/src/lib.rs:1` — module header still reads "Phase-0 spike shim… prove and measure" over production traffic; retitle.

Naming:
- `spike/regress.sh:624-629` — `pool_teardown` iterates slot indices in a variable named `pid`; actively wrong.
- `spike/run.sh:248-249` — `assert_legs_ran`'s local `lines` holds a file path; rename.
- `spike/run.sh:525` — bare timer `t` among suffixed siblings.
- `spike/slots.sh:497-499` — `cti_slot_mark_run` uses bare `$1`/`$2` where every sibling binds named locals.

Small error handling / hygiene:
- `spike/regress.sh:191` — no `nullglob`: an empty probes dir makes `ALL=("*")` and the "no probes" die never fires.
- `spike/regress.sh:44-45,294` — `HOST` has two birth-points and `RUNS_DIR` derives from the unvalidated one.
- `spike/run.sh:94-116` — a second CLI argument is silently ignored; refuse it.
- `spike/run.sh:364` (`waited`), `spike/regress.sh:136-141` (`spec`, `n`) — unlocalised variables.
- `spike/tier-lock.sh:127-131` — no trap on signal-kill leaves `$INFO` beside a freed lock (tolerated by consumers; add the tolerance note or the trap).
- `justfile` `probe` — `&& echo probe_done || true` where a plain if reads straighter.
- `extension/src/lib.rs:305-307` — `round_trip_persistent` discards the first exchange's error; report both when the reconnect also fails.

Gated, human-facing (not for an agent to land bare): CLAUDE.md's command table lacks a `just generate` row — needs sign-off or an ADR-0013 record.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Each item applied or declined with a sentence at the site.
- [ ] `just fast` green; `just regress --list` output unchanged.

Cross-reference: #154 (findings 36-43, 48-52, 56-65), #92, #161.
